title: Locate Spatial Factory Golden App 001 and report whether it runs
objective: Find the entry point of the spatial application referred to as Golden App 001. Report its file path, its build command and exit code, its test command and exit code, and whether it runs unattended for 30 minutes. If no runnable entry point exists anywhere, report that as the finding. Do NOT build, fix, or improve anything.
acceptance_test: projects/spatial/GOLDEN_APP_001.md exists and contains either (a) an absolute entry_point_path plus a build command with its observed exit code, or (b) an explicit NOT_FOUND verdict naming every path searched. A non-producer can re-run the named build command and observe the same exit code.
notes: Unblocks Ratatoskr P0 IMPLEMENT_AND_CLOSE_INSTITUTION_KERNEL_V0_ON_SPATIAL_FACTORY_GOLDEN_APP_001, which assumes this app is locatable. Falsifier F5 of SIGRUN_RECONCILIATION_WITH_RATATOSKR_20260731.md. Either outcome is valuable: a path unblocks the P0, a NOT_FOUND falsifies its premise.
